name: hollow hill

attributes.attribute: Irish folkloric site holding fairy palaces within it
a region close to our world yet not part of it

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The hollow hill is an Irish folkloric site. The idea that some hills are hollow shapes Irish tales. A hollow hill holds fairy palaces within it. The image fits the Irish view of the Otherworld as a place close to our world yet not part of it.

okr.objective: Document the hollow hill as an Irish folkloric site.
key_results: Record the idea that some hills are hollow.
Describe the fairy palaces the hills hold.
Link the image to the Irish view of the Otherworld.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): hollow hill entry.
